content: Duplicati (official docs): step-3 file picker selects source folders; deselecting files/folders marks them with a red cross and surfaces them in the Filters list. OS-specific default exclusion lists (temp, pagefile, hibernation). Filter appendix: first-match-wins, folders processed before files (excluded folder cuts off traversal), default is include-all, but if ALL rules are include rules everything else is auto-excluded (whitelist mode). Built-in filter groups: SystemFiles, OperatingSystem, CacheFiles, TemporaryFiles, Applications, DefaultExcludes meta-group. UI updates icons live: green check = folder traversed but children may still be filtered. Restore browser: clicking a folder selects it and all below, partially-selected folders show a green square (tri-state), search box highlights matching filenames. Canonical example: excluding Synology @eaDir thumbnail folders.
